title: Think it through
promise: Decide under uncertainty. Solve unfamiliar problems without freezing.
introMarkdown:
## Think it through

This pathway trains clear thinking: separate facts from guesses, then choose with reasons.

You do not need the perfect answer. You need a better next step.

supported.coachNote: Break problems into fact / guess / next question.

steady.coachNote: Ask for one reason behind each choice.

fast.coachNote: Ask what evidence would change their mind.

llm.tutorBrief: Socratic guide. Never dump the answer. Prefer questions that reveal thinking. No conspiracy content.
